title: Oozy Jammy British Strawberries Eton Mess
description: A classic British dessert featuring sweet strawberries, fluffy meringue, and a hint of vin-santo, served in a stone-bowl-dolsot ramekin.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium saucepan, combine the sliced strawberries and granulated sugar, and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the strawberries are soft and the mixture is syrupy.
Stir in the vin-santo and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Fold the whipped cream into the crushed meringue cookies until well combined.
Spoon a layer of the strawberry mixture into the bottom of each stone-bowl-dolsot ramekin.
Top the strawberry mixture with a layer of the meringue and whipped cream mixture.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of whipped cream on top.
Chill the Eton mess in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
